- For even $ n \geq 2 $, the term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by 23.
- For odd $ n \geq 2 $, the term is obtained by dividing the previous term by 23.

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
23 & \text{if } n = 0, \\
2 & \text{if } n = 1, \\

a(n-1) \div 23 & \text{if } n \geq 2 \text{ and } n \text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
$$
